Nested Conditions

Choices inside choices — and the flattening that tames them.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Weekend? Open. Sunny?

Inner asks only if outer says yes.

🪆

Russian dolls. Outer asks “weekend?” — only YES opens it to find “sunny?” inside. Two levels fine; five deep and nobody knows which doll they’re in. Paths multiply: 3 levels ≈ 8 paths.

ProgramRead each line in order
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    boolean weekend = true;
    boolean sunny = false;
    if (weekend) {
      if (sunny) {
        System.out.println("Picnic");
      } else {
        System.out.println("Museum");
      }
    } else {
      System.out.println("Work");
    }
  }
}

Weekend true opens; sunny false picks inner else.

Flatten when possible: if (weekend && sunny) halves the paths.
